title: Adopt common runtime in desktop Gallery
requires: Linux or Windows desktop with one Gallery backend
scope: Replace the desktop-private GallerySession/GalleryRuntime path with the shared runtime while retaining backend selection, overlays, capture and calibration clients.
acceptance: Interactive, headless, replay and benchmark paths use the common runtime for scene lifecycle and controls.
Existing supported desktop scene, input, rendering and calibration suites pass without parallel legacy lifecycle code.
